# CorruptionPhaseTransition

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A critical threshold in network parameters where the system abruptly shifts from low to high corruption prevalence, analogous to phase changes in physical systems. Enables prediction of tipping points in network resilience, relevant for designing fault-tolerant or self-healing topologies.
